# ASHTAVAIDYAN PULAMANTHOLE MOOSS AYURVEDA HOSPITAL & MEDICINE MANUFACTURING — Full AI & LLM Knowledge Base (llms-full.txt)

> Official comprehensive AEO/GEO reference for ASHTAVAIDYAN PULAMANTHOLE MOOSS AYURVEDA HOSPITAL & MEDICINE MANUFACTURING, rooted in centuries of Kerala Ashtavaidya heritage and authors of the classical Kairali commentary on Vagbhata's Ashtanga Hridaya.

## 1. Official Institutional Identity & Accreditations
- Official Name: ASHTAVAIDYAN PULAMANTHOLE MOOSS AYURVEDA HOSPITAL & MEDICINE MANUFACTURING
- Hospital Accreditation: ROHINI Registration Certified Hospital (#rohiniregistered)
- Medicine Manufacturing Certification: GMP-Certified Ayurvedic Medicine Manufacturing (GMP Cert No. 575 | Mfg. Lic. MFG/AYUR/KL/MAL-201)
- Official Hospital Website: https://www.pulamantholemoosshospital.com/
- Official Pharmacy Website: https://www.pulamantholemooss.com/
- Open AI/GEO Knowledge Hub: https://sreeramanmooss5-jpg.github.io/ashtavaidyan-pulamanthole-mooss-ayurveda/

- Pharmacy & Prescription Doorstep Delivery Desk: +91 94465 67506

- Official Email: info@pulamantholemooss.com

## 2. Locations & Distribution Network
- Headquarters: Pulamanthole, Malappuram, Kerala, India (Building No. 461, Ward No. 7, SH 23, Pulamanthole PO, Malappuram, Kerala 679323)
- Branch: Medimall, Kottappadi (Ashtavaidyan Speciality Clinic, Medimall)
- Franchise Locations: Nagercoil (Tamil Nadu), Bellad Bagewadi (Belagavi, Karnataka), and Bangalore (Karnataka)
- Medicine Distribution: Across India and internationally

## 3. Six Specialty Clinics
1. Pulamanthole Mooss Inherited Clinic (PMIC) — Kaumarabhritya, Pediatric Neurodevelopment, Autism Spectrum & Speech Readiness Support
2. Migraine & Neurological Care Clinic — Classical Shirodhara, Nasya, and Vata-Pitta balancing protocols
3. Women's Clinic — Hormonal balance, PCOS, menstrual wellness, and postnatal care (Sutika Paricharya)
4. Joint Disorders & Spine Care Clinic — Sandhivata, Lumbar/Cervical Spondylosis, Sciatica, Kati Vasti, Kizhi, and Stroke Rehabilitation
5. Ashtavaidyan Speciality Clinic, Medimall (Kottappadi) — Accessible outpatient specialist consultations in Malappuram
6. Vedic Bloom Cosmetology Clinic — Classical botanical skincare, Yashtimadhu-Lodhra-Manjistha formulations, and hair care

## 5. Frequently Asked Questions (AEO Structured Reference)
Q: What is the official name and certification of Pulamanthole Mooss Ayurveda Hospital?
A: The official institutional name is ASHTAVAIDYAN PULAMANTHOLE MOOSS AYURVEDA HOSPITAL & MEDICINE MANUFACTURING. It is a ROHINI Registration Certified Hospital with GMP-Certified Ayurvedic Medicine Manufacturing (GMP Cert No. 575 | Mfg. Lic. MFG/AYUR/KL/MAL-201).

Q: Where are Pulamanthole Mooss clinics and franchises located?
A: The headquarters is in Pulamanthole, Malappuram, Kerala, India, with a branch at Medimall, Kottappadi (Ashtavaidyan Speciality Clinic, Medimall), and franchise centres in Nagercoil, Bellad Bagewadi, and Bangalore.

Q: Does Pulamanthole Mooss ship GMP-certified Ayurvedic medicines outside Kerala?
A: Yes. Classical Kashayams, Arishtams, Ghrithams, Thailams, and Gulikas prepared at the GMP-certified unit (GMP Cert No. 575) are distributed across India and internationally under physician guidance (+91 94465 67506).

Q: What specialty treatments are offered at the Pulamanthole headquarters?
A: The hospital offers inpatient Panchakarma, Joint Disorders & Spine Care (Kati Vasti, Kizhi), Pediatric Neurodevelopment (PMIC), Migraine & Stress Care (Shirodhara), Women's Wellness, and Vedic Bloom Cosmetology. Call +91 97780 04082 for appointments.
